key_facts: On or about August 2024, Plaintiff was hired to work at The Home Depot distribution/fulfillment center at 5395 Hopkins Road, Tracy, CA 95377. He accepted the position and began onboarding. Home Depot ran a background check. Thereafter Home Depot ghosted him. Plaintiff is a registrant. The report is in Home Depot's files. The claim is Home Depot's own report and decision, not off a different employer's file. No offer letter, time records, wage statements, vendor name, or adverse-action notice is in the portfolio.
